title: Fragment-Based Design of Small Molecules to Study DNA Minor Groove Recognition.
authors: Verma, Smita; Patidar, Rajesh Kumar; Tiwari, Ratnesh; Velayutham, Ravichandiran; Ranjan, Nihar
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过片段策略设计苯并咪唑-胍盐杂合小分子，结合分子对接研究其DNA小沟槽序列选择性识别，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作启发的小分子-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移但非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: DNA-protein interactions are ubiquitous in cellular processes. Impeding unwanted nucleic acid interactions and protein recognition have therapeutic implications. Therefore, new chemical scaffolds and studies related to their structural basis of nucleic acid recognition are essential for developing high-affinity DNA binders. In this study, we have employed a fragment-based strategy to design and synthesize benzimidazole-guanidinium hybrid compounds and study the individual fragment's role in imparting selectivity and specificity in DNA recognition. The fragments were extensively studied using thermal denaturation, circular dichroism, UV-vis absorption spectroscopy, and molecular docking techniques. The results indicate an interdependent role of the benzimidazole core, polar ends, and the DNA composition in imparting sequence-selective binding of the benzimidazole-guanidinium hybrid compounds in the DNA minor groove. Circular dichroism and molecular docking studies indicated minor groove binding analogous to classical minor groove binders such as DAPI and Hoechst 33258. Thermal denaturation studies indicated that the best binder (compound 8) gave similar thermal stabilization to B-DNA as given by DAPI.
abstract_zh: DNA-蛋白质相互作用在细胞过程中普遍存在。阻碍不必要的核酸相互作用和蛋白质识别具有治疗意义。因此，新的化学骨架及其核酸识别结构基础的相关研究对于开发高亲和力DNA结合剂至关重要。在本研究中，我们采用基于片段（fragment-based）的策略设计并合成了苯并咪唑-胍（benzimidazole-guanidinium）杂合化合物，并研究了各片段在赋予DNA识别选择性和特异性中的作用。通过热变性、圆二色光谱、紫外-可见吸收光谱和分子对接技术对片段进行了广泛研究。结果表明，苯并咪唑核心、极性末端和DNA组成在赋予苯并咪唑-胍杂合化合物在DNA小沟中的序列选择性结合方面具有相互依赖的作用。圆二色光谱和分子对接研究表明，其小沟结合方式类似于经典小沟结合剂如DAPI和Hoechst 33258。热变性研究表明，最佳结合剂（化合物8）对B-DNA的热稳定性提升与DAPI相当。
